Add weekly timesheet rows per worker

timesheet_lines gives one line per worker with the shift count and total hours to one decimal place, busiest workers first. An empty list of shifts or a blank worker name raises ValueError.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

after.hourglass/timesheet.py:
"""Weekly timesheet rows, one line per worker."""

from typing import List

from hourglass.models import Shift
from hourglass.schedule import (
    shifts_for_worker,
    worker_minutes
)

def check_shifts(shifts: List[Shift]) -> None:
    """Refuse an empty list or a blank worker name."""
    if not shifts:
        raise ValueError("no shifts given")
    if any(not shift.worker.strip() for shift in shifts):
        raise ValueError("a shift has a blank worker name")

def timesheet_line(shifts: List[Shift], worker: str) -> str:
    """Name, shift count and total hours for one worker."""
    found = shifts_for_worker(shifts, worker)
    hours = sum(shift.span.minutes for shift in found) / 60
    count = len(found)
    return f"{worker}: {count} shifts, {hours:.1f} hours"

def timesheet_lines(shifts: List[Shift]) -> List[str]:
    """One line per worker, busiest first."""
    check_shifts(shifts)
    totals = worker_minutes(shifts)
    order = sorted(
        totals,
        key=lambda name: (-totals[name], name)
    )
    return [timesheet_line(shifts, name) for name in order]
